Evaluation guide

These settings describe the measurements in Section 5.5 of the survey. The input manifest lists each method, sample, and actual source and target frame indices. The result table provides the metrics before display rounding.

Hardware and cost

The measurements used Ubuntu 26.04, an Intel Core Ultra 7 265, an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, and 128 GB of RAM. Total time is the mean across samples of the median of three runs per sample. VRAM is peak allocated GPU memory, and parameter counts describe the inference system. Precomputed depth-prior generation for CylinderSplat is timed separately.

Benchmark settings

BenchmarkInputs and referenceMeasures
DTU15 scans, 3 source images, reference point clouds. The known-camera and unknown-camera setups appear separately.Accuracy, completeness, and overall error in mm.
RealEstate10K20 clips, 2 or 6 source views with known cameras, and 8 held-out targets per clip at 256 × 256.PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS.
ScanNet8 windows and 3 RGB inputs for geometry and pose. A separate FreeSplat pair compares 3 and 10 inputs on the same windows with 4 targets each at 384 × 512.Surface errors, F-score at 5 cm, pose errors and AUC at 30°. The FreeSplat pair uses image metrics.
Matterport3D10 sequences and 2 panoramas per sequence at a 2 m baseline. Synthesis uses a held-out ERP target at 512 × 1024. Perspective models use six 90° faces.WS-PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS. The geometry setup separately evaluates baseline-aligned depth, fused point clouds, and pose.

Reading the files

  • Accuracy and completeness use the common evaluation region. For ScanNet geometry, the first frame sets the similarity alignment and the remaining two frames provide the scored surfaces.
  • The full results CSV stores F-scores as fractions, AUC at 30° in percent, parameter counts as counts, and timing in seconds. The chart and setup downloads convert units as shown in the labels.
  • The method index links to the corresponding papers and author-provided resources. Dataset entries point to the references used in the survey.
